description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'MockZigbeeDevice' which models a mock Zigbee device for testing or simulation purposes, including methods for device identification, configuration, and cluster management.

classes.name: MockZigbeeDevice
classes.description: An abstract class representing a mock Zigbee device with properties like name, endpoints, and device attributes, supporting methods to manage endpoints, device info, and clusters.

methods.name: joinComplete
methods.description: Method called when the device has completed joining a Zigbee network.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the EUI-64 of the device's parent device.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the EUI-64 of the device's parent device.

methods.name: findServerClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds and returns a server cluster of a specified type from the device's endpoints.

methods.name: findRequiredServerClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds a server cluster of a specified type or throws if not found.

methods.name: findClientClusterOfType
methods.description: Finds and returns a client cluster of a specified type.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer string from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the model string from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getZigbeeHardwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the Zigbee hardware version from the basic cluster.

methods.name: getZigbeeFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version from the OTA upgrade cluster.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version as a formatted string.

methods.name: getHardwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the hardware version as a string.
